topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't shake this heavy feeling in my chest, like a fog settling in a quiet valley. I keep replaying our calls, wondering if there was a clue I missed. How can someone just... not remember? It’s like I’m the only one holding onto all these shared memories. I want to reach out, maybe jog their memory, but I’m stuck, afraid they might feel pressured or uncomfortable. Maybe I should just let it go, but these moments we had, they mean a lot to me. I guess I’m just hoping, in all this silence, for a spark to reignite our connection. It’s a fragile thing, hoping.
